name: Magic User Interface
runtimeDependencies: BCWB startup assigns MUI: to SYS:Expansion/MUI and adds its Libs, Locale and Docs to the corresponding system assigns
guigfx.library and render.library for the optional Guigfx.mcc class
notes: The installed muimaster.library is 19.35. The MUI 3.8 user archive supplies the matching base files, and stock path spelling and metadata come from the installed inventory.
This entry owns the installed MUI tree, including shared third-party classes and their local documentation. The 68020 Guigfx.mcc 19.2 and its guide come from MCC_Guigfx.lha.

Matching third-party archive members are pinned individually. The checked BCWB payload supplies replacement icons, additional images and stock class or documentation files whose exact upstream members are unresolved.
The AmigaSYS 4 AGA R1.3 redistribution supplies the shipped 68020 BetterString 11.15, HotkeyString 12.11 and TextEditor 15.27 class files.
The HstWB redistribution of ClassicWB v28 supplies byte-identical 2005 68020 NList classes, the English TextEditor guide and other shared MUI add-ons.
The BCWB default MUI icon is installed in ENVARC:Sys. The shared system drawers, S/User-Startup, and iGame and Voodoo-X settings in ENVARC:mui are outside this package.
